#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class IntList {
public:
    int *data;
    int size;
    int capacity;

    IntList() : data(new int[3]), size(0), capacity(3) {}

    ~IntList() { delete[] data; }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }

    int getSize() const { return size; }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() { size = 0; }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= capacity) {
            capacity = (capacity << 1) + 1;
            int *newData = new int[capacity];
            memcpy(newData, data, size * sizeof(int));
            delete[] data;
            data = newData;
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        expand();
        memmove(data + index + 1, data + index, (size - index) * sizeof(int));
        data[index] = value;
        size++;
    }

    int deleteAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int value = data[index];
        memmove(data + index, data + index + 1, (size - index - 1) * sizeof(int));
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        return data[--size];
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        memmove(data + 1, data, size * sizeof(int));
        data[0] = value;
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data[0];
        memmove(data, data + 1, (size - 1) * sizeof(int));
        size--;
        return value;
    }
};

class IntIntMap {
public:
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    map<int, int> mp;

    bool isEmpty() const { return mp.empty(); }

    int size() const { return mp.size(); }

    void clear() { mp.clear(); }

    bool have(int key) const {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        return mp.find(key) != mp.end();
    }

    int get(int key, int defaultVal) const {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        auto it = mp.find(key);
        return it == mp.end() ? defaultVal : it->second;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        mp[key] = value;
    }

    void deleteKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        mp.erase(key);
    }
};

int n, m;

IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList b = solve(mid, to);
        int aSize = a.getSize();
        int bSize = b.getSize();
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = i == 0 ? 0 : b.get(i - 1);
            int bTo = i == bSize - 1 ? n : b.get(i + 1);
            int bShift = b.get(i);
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0;
            int r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int mIdx = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (a.get(mIdx) <= aFrom) {
                    l = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    r = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + a.get(cur));
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = a.get(cur);
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res.push(bTo);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    n = 0; m = 0;
    int s, ct;
    long long t;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    istringstream iss(line);
    iss >> n >> m;
    getline(cin, line);
    istringstream iss2(line);
    iss2 >> s >> t;
    s--;
    ct = t % n;
    while (ct > 0) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
        ct--;
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.getSize();
        IntList cycleList;
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (long long it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0;
            int r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int mIdx = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (cycleSolve.get(mIdx) <= s) {
                    l = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    r = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            s += cycleSolve.get(l);
        }
    }
    cout << s + 1 << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
